note: Round-18 O claim: the flagless, sha-pinned resolution channel for non-D2 pipelines. Matching is by the graded packet's own `assembly.generator` string, never by filename. No filed receipt is edited by a re-pin; the pins move in this file and are recorded in the round's fragments.
